title: The score-4 gate must be a GENUINE invention win on an INVENTION-shaped corpus — vacuous dominance ties and plain best-of-N wins do NOT count
data_grounding: DIR-3 (r175s3_dir3) byte-verified: win+tie 0.917 CI[0.615,0.998] 'gate_met' BUT champions = baseline 7 / plain 4 / contradiction 1; 7/12 rows pipeline_chars==baseline_chars (the pipeline EMITS the baseline answer = vacuous dominance TIE); the 3 wins = 2 plain (single-shot best-of-N behavior) + 1 contradiction; the DEPARTURE (cross-domain invention) strategy won 0. The f31e corpus is MITIGATION-correctness shape (builder's own honest note), not invention shape. So the 'gate MET' is mostly vacuous: the pipeline ties best-of-N by selecting the baseline answer; genuine invention value-add = 1 contradiction win.
amendment: The score-4 capability gate requires: (1) an INVENTION-shaped corpus (novel-discovery / rediscovery problems, NOT mitigation-correctness), AND (2) the pipeline's OWN novel candidates (departure/cross-domain/contradiction) win >=50% — NOT vacuous dominance ties (pipeline==baseline) and NOT plain single-shot best-of-N wins. Dominance-by-construction guarantees non-loss but is NOT evidence of invention value. KILL CRITERION (reviewer): on mitigation, best-of-N+verifier ~= the pipeline; ship best-of-N+verifier for mitigation and focus the architecture on invention-shaped problems.
score: stays 3 — no genuine invention win demonstrated; the DIR-3 'gate MET' is vacuous on mitigation; the invention test must move to an invention-shaped corpus (rediscovery P5 / novel-discovery DEV).
